Карнозин.about: There are no direct MAs for carnosine - only data through the precursor β-alanine (increases muscle carnosine and performance), the effect is indirect.
Карнозин.caution: β-alanine increases the risk of paresthesia (OR 8.9, MA 2019); ALT is slightly higher, but within normal limits; There is little safety data for carnosine itself.
Карнозин.food_sources: Carnosine is found in meat, poultry, fish (especially beef); β-alanine - in muscle tissue of animals.
Карнозин.guidelines: MA 2017 (40 studies, n=1461): overall ES 0.18, exercises 0.5-10 min - 0.50; SR 2025: 4-6.4 g/day in fractions, 5-8 weeks; risk analysis 2019: paresthesia OR 8.9, ALT within normal limits.
Карнозин.how_to_choose: If the goal is performance, consider β-alanine (fractional doses of 4-6.4 g/day); The carnosine supplement itself has been less studied.
mechs: Increasing muscle carnosine due to β-alanine
Buffering of H+ ions during high-intensity work
best effect on strength and power at 4-6.4 g/day (SR 2025)
Карнозин.myths: “Carnosine = β-alanine” is a precursor, related but different substances. “Quick effect” - weeks of accumulation are needed. “Paresthesia is a sign of performance” is a side effect of β-alanine (OR 8.9), not carnosine directly.
Карнозин.name: Carnosine
Карнозин.onset: After several weeks of accumulation: β-alanine 4-6.4 g/day 5-8 weeks (SR 2025); For carnosine itself, the timing has not been established.
Карнозин.title: Carnosine
Карнозин.who_needs: High-intensity athletes - data via β-alanine precursor (exercise capacity 0.5-10 min, ES 0.50); There is little direct data on carnosine supplementation itself.
